amount.description: quantity times unit_price, with six decimals.

item.description: What it is: "monthly_fee", or a Prices field, such as "cpu".

priceEffectiveTime.description: When the price took effect, for a PAY_AS_YOU_GO line.

quantity.description: How much of it, in unit-hours with up to six decimals, such as "1440.5" vCPU-hours; "1" for a whole month's fee, a fraction for part.

unit.description: The unit quantity counts, such as "vCPU-hour" or "month".

unitPrice.description: The price of one unit, as the PriceList or the account gave it.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.StatementSpec.description: StatementSpec is the bill, as the apiserver made it.

accountUid.description: The uid of the BillingAccount that made it.

end.description:
StatementEnd is why a period ended.

- STATEMENT_END_PERIOD: It ran its length.
- STATEMENT_END_AGREEMENT_CHANGED: The account's agreement changed.
- STATEMENT_END_ACCOUNT_DELETED: The account was deleted, with its tenant or alone.

lines.description: What is billed, one line for the fee of a FIXED account, or one for each thing held at each price for a PAY_AS_YOU_GO one.

metered.description: What the period's holdings came to at the account's PriceList, when a FIXED account names one; for the record, not billed.

plan.description: The Plan whose fee a FIXED account paid.

total.description: The lines' amounts together, rounded to the currency's minor unit.

type.description:
BillingType is how a tenant pays.

- BILLING_TYPE_FIXED: A fee each month, whatever the tenant holds.
- BILLING_TYPE_PAY_AS_YOU_GO: What the tenant holds, minute by minute, at a PriceList's prices.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.StatementStatus.description: StatementStatus says whether it is paid.

paidTime.description: When it was paid, as the administrator recorded it; unset while it is not.

hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Statement is what a tenant owes for one period of its BillingAccount. The apiserver makes it as the period ends, and nothing changes it after but its payment, which a platform administrator records (StatementPaymentService). It outlives its tenant. Its name is the tenant's and the period's start, as "acme-202611010000". See docs/decisions/billing.md.
title: Statement
